meta.name: microservices-patterns
meta.description: Design microservices architectures with service boundaries, event-driven communication, and resilience patterns. Use when building distributed systems, decomposing monoliths, or implementing microservices.

copy.tagline: 设计微服务架构与交互模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正需要设计微服务架构或拆分已有系统。
copy.tagline_en: Design microservices with patterns for boundaries, events, resilience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing microservices or breaking up a monolith.

howto.what: 当对话涉及微服务时，Claude 会依据技能里的分解策略、通信模式、数据管理、弹性模式等给出架构设计建议；若需要详细示例，会读取 references/details.md。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建分布式系统、拆分单体应用或实现微服务等情况时触发。

say.text: 帮我把订单系统拆成微服务，说清楚服务边界。
say.note: Claude会给出服务边界和拆分步骤。

say.text: 支付和订单服务之间用同步还是异步通信？
say.note: Claude会根据通信模式分析利弊。

say.text: 跨微服务事务可以用Saga模式处理吗？

howto.what_en: Claude can answer microservices design questions using this skill's patterns: decomposition, communication, data management, resilience. It reads references/details.md when details are needed.
howto.when_en: Activated when the user asks to build distributed systems, decompose a monolith, or implement microservices, etc.

say_en.text: Break my order system into microservices and clarify service boundaries.
say_en.note: Claude suggests service boundaries and a decomposition plan.

say_en.text: Should payment and order services use sync or async communication?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes trade-offs based on communication patterns.

say_en.text: Can Saga handle transactions that span multiple microservices?
say_en.note: Claude explains Saga and compensating actions.
